name: Explicit Lookup Table
description: Replaced the bitwise-OR operation with a direct lookup table for edge scores, where matching modes score 1 or 2, and differing modes score 3. The validity condition requires the sum of all edge scores to be exactly 3m. This breaks the surface pattern of bitwise operations that models map to graph coloring, forcing them to deduce that a sum of 3m from a maximum edge score of 3 requires every edge to have differing modes.
